title: Frostline: Last Train to Haven
tagline: One shovel, two fires, eight passengers and 100 km of snow.
pitch: You're the only crew left on the last train out. The engine wants coal so it can outrun the raiders, and the passengers want coal so they don't freeze. You can't make both happy. Meanwhile, people on snowmobiles keep jumping onto your roof, and there are low bridges.
bad_idea_note: one bulb short of us needing a lawyer
controls: Unzip and run Frostline.exe. A/D move, W/S climb ladders, Space jump, E to do stuff, J to bonk raiders, and S on a roof to duck. Duck. Seriously.
